items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Minnie Riperton.

ctx.x: Yeah, Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Minnie Riperton. But I don’t think I had anything to do with it. It’s just I happened to be around just before they passed. It was shortly thereafter. I recorded with her. It was almost like a death knell, after I played with them.

You were on one tune called Obsession on this cut, and Milton Nascimento sang with her on this. I have this at home. So I remember this. Mean Lean. So we can trace it from it’s very first recording, back on Atlantic, through to In the Beginning, where it shows up as the closing, and then now – so every decade there seems to be another version.
